run_notes: videos_rgb on this data is *.png, not *.jpg as AriaLocalPairs globs for -- worked around with a scratch-only symlink tree at /tmp/adt_shadow/<seq>/ (*.jpg symlinks to the real *.png files, plus symlinks for depth_npy and groundtruth/aria_trajectory.csv); not committed, not a change to any repo file, same accommodation as #29 (see results/autoresearch-h22-sixseq/meta.json).
H2_CACHE=/tmp/h2_cross_cache, shared across all six folds so each sequence's DA3-Small forward pass + final-block token cache is computed once and reused across the five folds it appears in.
--max-frames 60 per sequence per the ticket; default --epochs 300.
protocol: leave-one-scene-out, 6 folds: for each held-out sequence, the head is trained on the other five (same DA3-Small feature-head recipe as #29) and evaluated on the held-out one.

near_center_center_damage.note: unlike #29's within-scene heads (near-center regressed by at most +5.8%), the decoration_seq132 fold shows real cross-scene collateral: near_center +66.5%, center +27.8%. The five clean-apartment folds stay in the same small-regression-to-improvement range as #29 (-22.8% to +10.1% center; near_center -21.8% to +10.1%, one outlier seq134 near_center +10.1%).
near_center_center_damage.per_fold: see per-run JSON for the full 8x5 before/after/counts matrices

read: One head, not six -- for the five mutually-similar clean-apartment sequences, cross-scene near-rim gain matches or exceeds the within-scene number on every one of them (-74.5% to -78.0% vs -46.7% to -71.3%), clearing the ticket's >=half-of-within-scene bar with room to spare. The exception is decoration_seq132: its cross-scene near-rim gain is markedly weaker (-18.7%, versus -21.2% within-scene -- still >=half) and, unlike the within-scene head, it now visibly damages near-center/center (+66.5%/+27.8%) -- the single head transfers cleanly within-genre but not fully to the visually distinct decoration variant.
